title: The Envoy-only line 'broker a shared claim on the wood (as an Envoy)' at the verderer's post resolves The Wood Question quest and narrates the exact outcome the Hunt's Stand grief's bargain requires ('warrant and coppice held in abeyance, the rides kept as they are'), but it does not set the flags the grief's bargain checks. After brokering (and gaining Crown+1/Ironbound+1/Barrow-Keepers+1), the Hunt's Stand's 'weigh what this grief asks' still read verbatim 'The bargain wants both refused, in Hornhallow: the verderer's warrant... and the factor's coppice...' as if nothing had happened, and both NPCs still offered their separate 'argue him out of/off' persuasion checks as live, unconsumed options.
where: Hunt's Stand — Muster Court / The Verderer's Post / The Ironbound Weigh-House
